page.loadError: Failed to load the raid events: {message}
page.pickServer: Pick a server above to see its events.
page.pastError: Failed to load the past raids: {message}
page.title: Raid events
page.info: All events of the selected server from Raid-Helper, upcoming and past. Signup call, raid sheet, logs and loot are inside the event itself.

list.openEventSub: Signups, raid sheet, logs and loot of this raid.
list.signupsSub: Accepted signups without absences, measured against the raid size of the content: Karazhan and Zul'Aman 10 spots, all other raids 25.
list.sizeKnown: Raid size from the recognised content.
list.sizeDefault: Content not recognised – measured against the default size of 25.
list.discordPostSubIn: Jumps to the signup message in #{channel}.
list.softresSub: The raid's soft reserve list on softres.it.
list.repeatSub: Create a new event using this one as a template: title, template and description carried over, channel cloned.
list.analysedSub: Click opens the event's logs with the analyses.
list.assignedSub: Click opens the event's logs, analyse them there.
list.pendingFits: “{title}” fits by time but is not assigned.
list.pendingSub: Click opens the event on the Logs tab, decide there.
list.noLogsSub: No Warcraft log is assigned to this raid, and none fits by time.
list.noLootSub: Click opens the loot import in History & loot.
list.logsSub: Assigned Warcraft logs (analysed or not) and open ones: logs that fit by time but are not assigned to any raid yet.
list.lootColSub: Imported loot of this raid. “missing”: nothing imported yet.

icon.unknownSub: Neither title nor category names a known raid.
